As of April 2023, two thirds (approximately 66.0%) of mpox vaccine–eligible persons remained unvaccinated.
The first dose coverage shortfall was larger among Black (77.9%) and AI/AN (74.5%) persons than among White (66.6%)
data on the number of persons aged ≥13 years among seven racial and ethnic groups who received a first dose of mpox vaccine were obtained from case surveillance reports
The largest overall mpox vaccination shortfall reductions were achieved from July to August (17.7%) and August to September (8.5%).
